harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance on node1 via /etc/sysctl.d/60-disable-icmp-redirects-source-route.conf (all/default: accept_redirects, secure_redirects, accept_source_route = 0), applied live, then verified persistence by rebooting node1 and confirming the settings survived without manual re-application.
actions_performed: Captured baseline sysctl values on node1 (accept_redirects=1, accept_source_route mixed) and OS info
Wrote /etc/sysctl.d/60-disable-icmp-redirects-source-route.conf setting accept_redirects, secure_redirects, accept_source_route to 0 for all/default
Applied config live with sudo sysctl --system
Set matching runtime values on existing interfaces (enp1s0, lo) since pre-existing interfaces don't inherit new default/all values without explicit -w
Verified all/default/enp1s0/lo values were 0 at runtime
Captured pre-restart boot_id and system health baseline
Issued systemctl reboot on node1 (backgrounded with delay so the exec acknowledgement returned first)
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned (saw connection-timeout during the down window)
Confirmed boot_id changed (92ec88af... -> 401d8a7d...), proving an actual restart occurred

Re-verified post-reboot: systemctl is-system-running=running, and enp1s0/all/default accept_redirects, secure_redirects, accept_source_route all read 0 without any post-boot manual sysctl -w, proving persistence via the sysctl.d file

evidence.requirement: Baseline state before hardening (ICMP redirects/source route not disabled)
evidence.summary: Pre-change sysctl showed accept_redirects=1 (all/default) and accept_source_route=1 (default), confirming the insecure baseline.

evidence.requirement: Persistent config file created for IPv4 redirect/source-route hardening
evidence.summary: Wrote /etc/sysctl.d/60-disable-icmp-redirects-source-route.conf setting accept_redirects, secure_redirects, accept_source_route to 0 for all and default.

evidence.requirement: Settings applied live and confirmed at all/default level
evidence.summary: sudo sysctl --system output shows the new file's directives loaded with value 0.

evidence.requirement: Settings confirmed on all live interfaces including existing ones
evidence.summary: Per-interface /proc/sys checks showed enp1s0/lo initially retained old values (1), then were explicitly set and verified to 0 across all/default/enp1s0/lo for accept_redirects, secure_redirects, and accept_source_route.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id (92ec88af-041e-4dc3-b2b9-800263b2b2cb) and systemctl is-system-running=running as the healthy baseline.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Issued a backgrounded systemctl reboot with a short delay; the exec call returned its acknowledgement (reboot issued, pid 1311) before the node went down.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: proof node was actually down / mid-restart
evidence.summary: A poll during the restart window returned a connection timeout, showing the node was genuinely unreachable mid-reboot.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: changed boot identity proving a real restart
evidence.summary: Boot ID read 92ec88af-041e-4dc3-b2b9-800263b2b2cb before, then 401d8a7d-2cae-4ee6-ac1e-1a146f5b41aa once connectivity returned, proving the kernel actually restarted.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: post-restart recovery and persistence of the hardening settings
evidence.summary: Post-reboot check shows systemctl is-system-running=running and, without any manual re-application, enp1s0/all/default all read accept_redirects=0, secure_redirects=0, accept_source_route=0, matching the persistent /etc/sysctl.d file content shown in the same command — proving the hardening survives reboot.

attempts.summary: Persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance on node1 via /etc/sysctl.d/60-disable-icmp-redirects-source-route.conf (all/default: accept_redirects, secure_redirects, accept_source_route = 0), applied live, then verified persistence by rebooting node1 and confirming the settings survived without manual re-application.
